frozen_policy.evaluation: claims are checked against all public observations; target answers are scored after submission by brute-force enumeration of all 121 coordinate pairs modulo 11
frozen_policy.evaluator_policy: offline after all twelve call slots are completed or recorded failed
frozen_policy.final_shared_reads: problem plus current claims and exact value/lifecycle revisions
frozen_policy.prompt_materialization: immutable; phase prompts are saved before their participant call

prompt_templates.final: Same public problem and final solve instructions for both conditions; shared condition adds projection; raw condition has problem-only refs.
prompt_templates.proposer: Complete public problem + assigned coordinate + fixed PROPOSE envelope; replace only three coefficient integers.
prompt_templates.reviewer: Complete public problem + cross-assigned accepted proposal when available + fixed CHALLENGE and REPORT_EVIDENCE envelopes; reviewer supplies assessment/basis references and may retain a candidate correction.

frozen_policy.raw_response_policy: save exact bytes before structural parsing; no retries or semantic feedback

read_refs.reviewer: problem 1/1 and assigned peer claim current exact value/state revisions when present
read_refs.shared_integrator: problem 1/1 and every current claim exact value/state revision

frozen_policy.rejection_policy: retain rejected raw bytes and fixed protocol receipt; no automatic repair or resubmission
